# IQS Directory

> > A comprehensive B2B industrial supplier marketplace and manufacturing directory connecting buyers with OEM manufacturers and equipment suppliers across diverse industrial categories.

IQS Directory is a leading industrial search platform and supplier database that helps manufacturers and businesses find specialized equipment, materials, and services. The platform leverages SEO, Google Analytics, and RFQ systems to connect industrial buyers with vetted suppliers across hundreds of product and service categories.

## Core Platform

- [IQS Directory Homepage](https://www.iqsdirectory.com): B2B manufacturing marketplace and supplier database for OEM manufacturers and industrial equipment sourcing

- [Customer Testimonials](https://www.iqsdirectory.com/testimonials): Success stories and client feedback from manufacturers and suppliers using IQS Directory

## Industrial Equipment & Machinery

- [Automation Equipment](https://www.iqsdirectory.com/automation-equipment): Factory and warehouse automation equipment manufacturers and suppliers for industrial operations
- [AGV (Automated Guided Vehicles)](https://www.iqsdirectory.com/agv): Automated guided vehicle manufacturers for material handling and warehouse automation solutions
- [Boilers](https://www.iqsdirectory.com/boilers): Industrial boiler manufacturers supplying steam and hot water heating systems
- [Blowers](https://www.iqsdirectory.com/blowers): Industrial blower and fan manufacturers for ventilation and air system applications
- [Air Pollution Control Equipment](https://www.iqsdirectory.com/air-pollution-control): Air pollution control and emission control equipment manufacturers for environmental compliance

## Materials & Manufacturing Services

- [Aluminum Extrusions](https://www.iqsdirectory.com/aluminum-extrusions): Aluminum extrusion manufacturers providing custom industrial fabrication solutions

- [Ceramic Machining](https://www.iqsdirectory.com/ceramic-machining): Precision ceramic machining services for custom industrial components and parts
